# A framework cited with no definition behind it

`Policy: pol-UNLK` `ACTIVE`

## Purpose

To write a mapping markdown never turned into a link. The brackets stay on the page as text, so the cell
offers no label. A policy could state an obligation to a framework across its clauses and show nothing
for it in `aligns-with`.

## Scope

Every service in the estate.

## Clauses

| Id      | Clause                                      | Alignment              |
|---------|---------------------------------------------|------------------------|
| `WRITE` | **MUST** define the label a clause cites.   | [UK GDPR].Art.5(1)(e)  |
| `AGAIN` | **MUST NOT** be told the same thing twice.  | [UK GDPR].Art.32(1)(d) |
